name: wow-aisuite
description: Analyse your Xero and QuickBooks backups from Claude — powered by WOW Backup & Restore.
long_description:
WOW AISuite connects Claude to your **WOW Backup & Restore** account so you can explore your Xero and QuickBooks backups in plain language: browse organisations and their dated backups, preview and describe files, aggregate figures, and compare two backups.

The server is remote and OAuth-protected — the first time a tool runs, you sign in through your browser. Nothing secret is stored in this extension.

Requires an active WOW Backup & Restore subscription.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Drill into the organisations you can access, their dated backups, and the files inside one backup.

tools.name: preview_file
tools.description: Preview a backup file: its columns and types, and a page of rows.

tools.name: aggregate_file
tools.description: Aggregate figures within a backup file, or sweep the same figure across organisations.

tools.name: find_uncategorized_balances
tools.description: The net balance sitting in uncategorised / catch-all accounts.

tools.name: compare_file_versions
tools.description: What changed in a file between two backup dates.

tools.name: get_live_data
tools.description: Read an organisation live from its accounting platform (Xero), when enabled.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Sign out and revoke the current session.
